arxiv-1405-3879.title: CP VIOLATION IN THE 𝑩 ( 𝒔 ) 𝟎 \bm{B^{0}_{(s)}} SYSTEM AT LHCb
arxiv-1405-3879.creator: F. DORDEI
arxiv-1405-3879.description: Abstract The study of C\!P violation in decays of neutral B mesons provides an important test of the Standard Model (SM) predictions and it is a sensitive probe to search for non-SM physics. In these proceedings I present measurements of C\!P violation in the neutral B meson system.

arxiv-1609-04377.title: Dynamical History Of The Local Group In Λ \Lambda CDM II − - Including External Perturbers In 3D 2017 Dynamical History Of The Local Group In Λ \Lambda CDM II − - Including External Perturbers In 3D – References
arxiv-1609-04377.creator: Indranil Banik, Hongsheng Zhao
arxiv-1609-04377.description: Abstract We attempt to fit the observed radial velocities (RVs) of ∼ \,{\sim}\, 30 Local Group (LG) galaxies using a 3D dynamical model of it and its immediate environment within the context of the standard cosmological paradigm, Λ \Lambda CDM. This extends and confirms the basic results of our previous axisymmetric investigation of the LG (MNRAS, 459, 2237).

arxiv-2104-04709.title: Practical Two-party Privacy-preserving Neural Network Based on Secret Sharing Volume: 00
arxiv-2104-04709.creator: Zhengqiang Ge, Zhipeng Zhou, Dong Guo, Qiang Li
arxiv-2104-04709.description: Abstract Neural networks, with the capability to provide efficient predictive models, have been widely used in medical, financial, and other fields, bringing great convenience to our lives. However, the high accuracy of the model requires a large amount of data from multiple parties, raising public concerns about privacy.

arxiv-2208-05631.title: Quantized Adaptive Subgradient Algorithms and Their Applications Conference: 2022; July; 2022 Price: 15.00 CCS: Computing methodologies Distributed computing methodologies
arxiv-2208-05631.creator: Ke Xu, Jianqiao Wangni, Yifan Zhang, Deheng Ye, Jiaxiang Wu and Peilin Zhao
arxiv-2208-05631.description: Abstract . Data explosion and an increase in model size drive the remarkable advances in large-scale machine learning, but also make model training time-consuming and model storage difficult. To address the above issues in the distributed model training setting which has high computation efficiency and less device limitation, there are still two main difficulties.

arxiv-2211-11153.title: Unifying Vision-Language Representation Space with Single-tower Transformer
arxiv-2211-11153.creator: Jiho Jang Chaerin Kong Donghyeon Jeon Seonhoon Kim Nojun Kwak, Seoul National University NAVER Coupang
arxiv-2211-11153.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Jiho Jang Chaerin Kong Donghyeon Jeon Seonhoon Kim Nojun Kwak, Seoul National University NAVER Coupang. Contrastive learning is a form of distance learning that aims to learn invariant features from two related representations. In this paper, we explore the bold hypothesis that an image and its caption can be simply regarded as two different views of the underlying mutual information, and train a model to learn a unified vision-language representation space that encodes both modalities at once in a modality-agnostic manner.

arxiv-2308-00585.title: The Role of Magma Oceans in Maintaining Surface Water on Rocky Planets Orbiting M-Dwarfs 2023 The Role of Magma Oceans in Maintaining Surface Water on Rocky Planets Orbiting M-Dwarfs – References
arxiv-2308-00585.creator: Keavin Moore, Nicolas B. Cowan, Charles-Édouard Boukaré
arxiv-2308-00585.description: Abstract Earth-like planets orbiting M-dwarf stars, M-Earths, are currently the best targets to search for signatures of life. Life as we know it requires water. The habitability of M-Earths is jeopardized by water loss to space: high flux from young M-dwarf stars can drive the loss of 3–20 Earth oceans from otherwise habitable planets.

arxiv-2403-06842.title: Hybrid optimal control with mixed-integer Lagrangian methods
arxiv-2403-06842.creator: Viktoriya Nikitina, Alberto De Marchi, Matthias Gerdts
arxiv-2403-06842.description: Abstract Models involving hybrid systems are versatile in their application but difficult to optimize efficiently due to their combinatorial nature. This work presents a method to cope with hybrid optimal control problems which, in contrast to decomposition techniques, does not require relaxing the integrality constraints. Based on the discretize-then-optimize approach, our scheme addresses mixed-integer nonlinear problems under mild assumptions.

arxiv-2405-02170.title: Fourier-Laplace transforms in polynomial Ornstein-Uhlenbeck volatility models
arxiv-2405-02170.creator: Eduardo Abi Jaber, Shaun (Xiaoyuan) Li, Xuyang Lin
arxiv-2405-02170.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Eduardo Abi Jaber, Shaun (Xiaoyuan) Li, Xuyang Lin. We consider the Fourier-Laplace transforms of a broad class of polynomial Ornstein-Uhlenbeck (OU) volatility models, including the well-known Stein-Stein, Schöbel-Zhu, one-factor Bergomi, and the recently introduced quintic OU models motivated by the SPX-VIX joint calibration problem. We show the connection between the joint Fourier-Laplace functional of the log-price and the integrated variance, and the solution of an infinite-dimensional system of Riccati equations.

arxiv-2505-19881.title: Effective potential of scalar Lee-Wick pseudo-electrodynamics
arxiv-2505-19881.creator: M. J. Neves
arxiv-2505-19881.description: Abstract The study of effective potential for the scalar Lee-Wick pseudo-electrodynamics in one-loop is presented in this letter. The planar and non-local Lee-Wick pseudo-electrodynamics is so coupled to a complex scalar field sector in 1 + 2 1+2 dimensions, where we achieve the Lee-Wick pseudo-scalar electrodynamics.

arxiv-2507-07905.title: Edge State Selective Measurement of Quantum Hall Dispersions
arxiv-2507-07905.creator: Henok Weldeyesus, T. Patlatiuk, Q. Chen, C. P. Scheller, A. Yacoby, L. N. Pfeiffer, K. W. West, D. M. Zumbühl
arxiv-2507-07905.description: Abstract Edge states reflect the key physical properties yet are difficult to probe individually, particularly when several states are present at an edge. We present momentum resolved tunneling spectroscopy between a quantum well and a quantum wire to extract the dispersions of the quantum Hall edge states.

pmc-11600318.creator: Ahmad Rashidi MOHAMED TAHIR, Voon Jia HAW, Wan Sazrina Wan ZAİD, Mariani Ahmad NİZARUDDİN, Fashli Syafiq ABD RAZAK, Arimi Fitri Mat LUDİN

Customers increasingly seek guidance about lifestyle factors that impact their health. Pharmacists with expertise in sports and exercise can meet this need.

pmc-12446223.title: Exploring the nutritional status in adults with chronic schizophrenia: a cross-sectional study in Ecuador
pmc-12446223.creator: José Alejandro Valdevila Figueira, Alfonso Daniel Silva Ochoa, Luz María Valencia Erazo, María Gracia Madero Dutazaka, Galya Bigman, Indira Dayana Carvajal Parra
pmc-12446223.description: IntroductionSchizophrenia (SCZ) and other related factors could be associated with specific nutritional problems. Some serum biomarkers could be involved in the clinical presentation of psychotic disorders. These individuals could have significantly lower bone mineral density (BMD) and a higher prevalence of osteoporosis comparatively.

pmc-12801460.title: MiR-143-5p serves as a diagnostic biomarker in patients with sepsis and regulates sepsis-induced inflammation and cardiac dysfunction
pmc-12801460.creator: Yaqi Wu, Le Gu, Xu Huang
pmc-12801460.description: Background & Objective. MicroRNAs (miRNAs) offer advantages in stability and therapeutic specificity. This study investigated the diagnostic and therapeutic potential of miR-143-5p in sepsis (SP) and SP-associated cardiac dysfunction (CD). ‌Methods. Quantitative Real-Time polymerase chain reaction (qRT-PCR) quantified serum and cellular miR-143-5p levels. Receiver operator characteristic (ROC) curve evaluated miR-143-5p’s diagnostic efficacy.

pmc-13006820.title: Development of CpG‐Depleted CFTR Plasmid‐Based Nanoparticles for Nonviral Gene Therapy in Lung Cystic Fibrosis Disease
pmc-13006820.creator: Bei Qiu, Maryann Lorino, Yinghao Li, Zhonglei He, Xianqing Wang, Wenxin Wang, Irene Lara‐Sáez
pmc-13006820.description: Nonviral gene therapy holds promise as a potential treatment for lung cystic fibrosis (CF). However, the transient expression of the CF transmembrane conductance regulator (CFTR) protein has limited its clinical application. To circumvent this challenge, a CpG‐depleted CFTR plasmid was developed.

pmc-13448916.creator: Min Eui Lee, Yeon-Jeong Jo, Junghyeon Kim, Suhyun Ok, Chaewoo Jeong, Hyo Won Kwak

pmc-13540722.title: Perforated duodenal tuberculosis with pancreaticobiliary disruption requiring salvage pancreaticoduodenectomy: a case report
pmc-13540722.creator: Mirko Lombardi, Tulia Hadi, Bahati Kamwezi, Lugano Wilson, Lusekelo Mwalukambwe, Edrick Elias, Tresphory Boniphace Kamushaga, Shama Mkini, Agnes Mlawa
pmc-13540722.description: Gastroduodenal tuberculosis is uncommon, and duodenal perforation is exceptional. A 25-year-old man from rural Tanzania presented with generalized peritonitis after prolonged epigastric symptoms, weight loss, night sweats, and household tuberculosis exposure. Emergency laparotomy showed destructive pyloroduodenal perforation with insufficient viable tissue for local repair; distal gastrectomy and Roux-en-Y gastrojejunostomy were performed.

pmc-13549196.title: Early Risk Stratification of Severe Trauma in the Emergency Department: Integrating Clinical Scoring Systems, Dynamic Biomarkers, and Artificial Intelligence—A Narrative Review
pmc-13549196.creator: Xiabing Sun, Jie Han, Jianjian Ni, Yujie Shen
pmc-13549196.description: Severe trauma remains a major global cause of death and disability, particularly among individuals younger than 45 years. Emergency departments are the main gateway to trauma care, where rapid risk stratification guides resuscitation, surgical decision-making, intensive care admission, and resource allocation.

pmc-13574655.title: Swyer syndrome complicated by rapidly progressive invasive ovarian dysgerminoma with bladder and rectal direct invasion: a rare case report
pmc-13574655.creator: Yuan Feng, Xueqin Chen, Yaru Xu, Meng Xia, Tengda Xie, Rong Yang, Kang Du, Yiou Chen
pmc-13574655.description: A 16-year-old patient with a female social gender was admitted because of “a pelvic mass detected for one year”, accompanied by primary amenorrhea and poorly developed secondary sexual characteristics. Laboratory tests after admission showed elevated levels of follicle-stimulating hormone and luteinizing hormone, decreased estradiol level, and increased levels of β-human chorionic gonadotropin and carbohydrate antigen 125.

pmc-13585116.title: Comparative Evaluation of the Effect of Different Storage Media on the Hardness and Fracture Resistance of Reattached Tooth Fragments: An In Vitro Study
pmc-13585116.creator: Mahesh V Dadpe, Nikita A Chordiya, Yogesh J Kale, Prasanna T Dahake, Shrikant B Kendre
pmc-13585116.description: AimTo assess hardness as well as resistance to fracture in the case of a reattached tooth fragment when different storage media are used.Materials and methodsIn this study, 60 permanent incisor teeth that were extracted for therapeutic reasons were enrolled and divided into four groups. Each group had 15 specimens (n = 15).

uslaw-usc-t5-s5525.title: 5 U.S.C. § 5525 — Allotment and assignment of pay
uslaw-usc-t5-s5525.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t5-s5525.description: United States Code, Title 5 (Government Organization And Employees); Part III (Employees); Subpart D (Pay And Allowances); Chapter 55 (Pay Administration); Subchapter III (Advancement, Allotment, And Assignment Of Pay). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The head of each agency may establish procedures under which each employee of the agency is permitted to make allotments and assignments of amounts out of his pay.
